title: 第13章 阳燧枝，百妖志
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陆玄在天仓殿中等候，但心中并不平静。

质问筑基，讨要灵物，不是一件易事。

也就是在鉴天教这等教派之中才可能做到，放在擎岳州之外，早就被人一巴掌拍死了。

前身出身鉴天教边境之地，见过太多人枉死小宗的例子。

虽然他两世为人，心怀野望，但并不代表行事可以毫无顾忌。

但……【锐】字在心，林山海之言在前，他必须一试。

这也就是他此前一定要死磕二次大醮的原因。

只有留在这等仙教大宗，才能说原则，谈教规。

小宗里面，只能任由上修拿捏。

“玄士请饮茶，我等已经禀告执事了，想必不久就有回应了。”

天仓殿中的中年值守，恭敬的奉上灵茶，陪在陆玄左右。

他们不过胎息之境，一生怕是都难以采炁功成，不敢得罪陆玄，更不敢得罪筑基执事，只能做个传声筒。

“谢过值守。”

陆玄自然也不会和这等人置气，饮了一口茶水，安心等候。

“咻！”

但没过多久，就有流光飞符自后殿之中飞出，落入那值守掌心，与此同时，还有一枚鎏金令牌落下。

那值守恭敬接过，连忙查看，而后面色一喜，赶忙对陆玄说道：“有了有了，执事有回应了。”

“执事有言，【元火剑砂】已被他取走，但合乎教规，不可置喙。”

“只能怪玄士你二次大醮，失了天时。”

“但本教行事至公，现予玄士你【鎏霞令】一枚，可于两日后，赴赤松藩，争【阳燧枝】。”

“这是比【火元剑砂】更胜一筹的开意窍之灵物，玄妙非常，但需赢得一场争斗方可得之。”

“具体信息，皆在此令之中，玄士你若是愿意，接过此令，自然就可知晓。”

那值守将飞符中谢枕石的话传达陆玄，随后又恭敬的捧起金令，等待陆玄的抉择。

陆玄闻言，微微讶然：“比【火元剑砂】更胜一筹？莫非是甲等上品的灵物？”

值守答道：“回玄士，正是甲等上品！”

陆玄顿时陷入思索。

火元剑砂不在，但却有了一个可以得到甲等上品灵物的机会。

该如何抉择？

“铮！”

说是思索，但玉碟之上铮铮颤动的“锐”字，已经给出了答案。

“既然如此，那就依执事之安排。”

陆玄伸手，接过了那【鎏霞令】。

霎时间，朗朗之音在陆玄耳边响起，数息之后，他就明白了一切的缘由。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lu Xuan was waiting in Tiancang Hall, but his heart was not at peace.

Questioning the foundation and asking for spiritual objects is not an easy task.

This is only possible among sects such as the Jiantian Sect. Outside of Qingyue Prefecture, someone would have slapped him to death.

My predecessor came from a place on the border of Jiantian Sect, and I have seen too many examples of people killing Xiaozong in vain.

Although he has been a man of two generations and has ambitions, it does not mean that he can act without any scruples.

But... the word [Rui] was in his heart and Lin Shanhai's words were in front of him. He had to give it a try.

This was the reason why he had to attend the second big ceremony before.

Only by staying in this class of immortal sects can we talk about principles and canons.

In Xiaozong, you can only let the superior cultivator control you.

"Master Xuan, please have tea. We have already reported it to the deacon. I believe there will be a response soon."

The middle-aged guard in Tiancang Hall respectfully served spiritual tea and accompanied Lu Xuan.

They are only in the state of fetal breath, and they may not be able to achieve success in harvesting Qi in their lifetime. They dare not offend Lu Xuan, let alone the Foundation Establishment Deacon, so they can only be a sounding board.

"Thank you for being on duty."

Naturally, Lu Xuan would not get angry with such people, so he took a sip of tea and waited with peace of mind.

"Phew!"

But not long after, a flying talisman of light flew out from the apse and fell into the palm of the guard. At the same time, a gilt token fell.

The guard took it respectfully and checked it quickly. Then he looked happy and said to Lu Xuan: "Yes, yes, the deacon has responded."

"The deacon said that the [Yuanhuo Sword Sand] has been taken away by him, but it is in compliance with religious rules and cannot be ignored."

"I can only blame you, Xuanshi, for losing your timing during the second big ceremony."

"However, our sect acts in an upright manner, and hereby give you, Xuan Shi, a [Liu Xia Ling], so that you can go to Chisong Domain in two days to fight for [Yang Suizhi]."

"This is a spiritual object that is better than [Fire Element Sword Sand] to open up the mind. It is very mysterious, but you need to win a battle to get it."

"The specific information is all in this order. If you, Xuanshi, are willing, you can naturally know it by accepting this order."

The guard conveyed the words of Xie Zhenshi in the flying talisman to Lu Xuan, and then respectfully held up the golden order and waited for Lu Xuan's decision.

When Lu Xuan heard this, he was slightly surprised: "Is it better than [Fire Element Sword Sand]? Could it be a top-grade spiritual object?"

The guard replied: "Hui Xuanshi, he is the first-class top grade!"

Lu Xuan suddenly fell into thinking.

The Fire Element Sword Sand is not here, but there is a chance to get a first-class high-grade spiritual object.

How to choose?

"Zheng!"

It was said that he was thinking, but the trembling word "Rui" on the jade plate already gave the answer.

"In that case, let's follow the deacon's arrangements."

Lu Xuan reached out and took the [Liuxia Ling].

Suddenly, a loud voice sounded in Lu Xuan's ears, and after a few breaths, he understood the reason for everything.
